rubrics.justification: Provides a careful, image-limited assessment of expansion, ICM, TE, and zona observations, and appropriately notes the Gardner stage inconsistency. Slightly hedged and somewhat speculative on exact stage/AA borderline, so not fully precise.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, male factor context, partner age, BMI, smoking, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with probability estimates tied to age, morphology, smoking, and lining. Minor tension between calling the embryo good quality and questioning whether it is truly AA, but overall coherent.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles, SET preference, caution about unproven add-ons, and selective use of PGT-A. Small deviation is the somewhat assertive interpretation of stage from a single static image despite lab grading.
Gives clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, SET, luteal support/timing, smoking cessation, avoiding routine add-ons, and structured next steps if unsuccessful.
